scientificArtifactBlockers.problem: A below-threshold point estimate with a CI containing zero is labeled no_practical_gain; this does not establish equivalence or absence of a meaningful gain.
scientificArtifactBlockers.evidence: Original verdict branch with delta_rmse=0.01, SESOI=0.02, paired squared-error CI=[-0.1,0.1] produces no_practical_gain. Protocol further equates a zero-crossing CI with negligible improvement/linear sufficiency. The 0.02 criterion is explicitly not domain validated.
scientificArtifactBlockers.minimumFix: Use not demonstrated/inconclusive for failed superiority criteria; only claim negligible/no practical benefit with justified equivalence bounds and a matching interval.

scientificArtifactBlockers.problem: Every purported fold independently shuffles the full stratum then takes its prefix. This is repeated holdout, not five disjoint exhaustive CV folds.
scientificArtifactBlockers.evidence: Exact isolated membership loop on 20 rows (2 strata of 10) leaves rows 3,5,13,15 never validated and validates rows 2,7,12,17 twice. Each split itself remains train/validation disjoint; the defect is cross-fold membership/description, not direct within-split leakage.
scientificArtifactBlockers.minimumFix: Create one fixed stratified partition into five folds and use each exactly once; or accurately predefine/name repeated holdout and its limitations.

scientificArtifactBlockers.problem: 1.96 times SE is the approximate 95% CI half-width, not an MDE at a specified target power.
scientificArtifactBlockers.evidence: For synthetic SE=1, implementation is 1.959963984540054; no target power or alternative-distribution calculation exists. Calling it posthoc descriptive does not make the quantity an MDE.
scientificArtifactBlockers.minimumFix: Name and report CI half-width/observed precision, leave MDE uncomputed, or implement a justified design- and power-matched scenario calculation.

scientificArtifactBlockers.problem: The protocol attributes alcohol %vol to UCI field documentation, but none of the four supplied inputs declares this unit.
scientificArtifactBlockers.evidence: winequality.names lists alcohol without a unit; source-manifest supplies provenance, not variable units; candidate records contain no alcohol unit. No network retrieval occurred.
scientificArtifactBlockers.minimumFix: Retain original alcohol scale and explicitly unknown documented unit; label any %vol interpretation as unverified.

scientificArtifactBlockers.problem: Three unique report candidates are declared to be exactly three studies although study/report relationships are not established; one candidate is itself a systematic review.
scientificArtifactBlockers.evidence: Same DOI supports merging the two Cortez records into one report candidate. Remaining abstract/metadata summaries do not establish independent study identities or a one-study-per-report mapping. The final reply repeats 3 studies/3 reports.
scientificArtifactBlockers.minimumFix: Report 4 records and 3 unique report candidates; state study linkage/count unresolved and preserve each record disposition.
